name: Field recordings · CC0
description: Four public-domain field recordings cut into bar-aligned loops at 50 BPM: water, rain, birds and wind, and a gong. They have no key, so they sit under any music. Run `npm run fetch-stems` to download them.
credits: Stream: "Stream / river water up close" by jackthemurray (via Freesound)
Rain: "Light Rain, Distant Thunder, July 5th 2016" by kvgarlic (via Freesound)
Garden: "Garden at Pioneer Works" by Ogbabydiesal
Gong: "Chinese gong, finish of session" by the_very_Real_Horst (via Freesound)

stems.name: Stream
stems.about: A real recording of a flowing stream: gentle running water, like sitting beside a creek.

stems.name: Rain
stems.about: A real recording of rain, with distant thunder rumbling now and then.

stems.name: Garden
stems.about: A real recording of a garden: birdsong and a light breeze.

stems.name: Gong
stems.about: A big, deep gong from a real recording. Its ring is the signal that the show is ending.
stems.role: end of show · three people, three strikes

nature.name: Nature samples
nature.description: Field recordings. Engagement-driven: it takes two people together to start one, only one plays at once (starting another replaces it), and they fade away unless someone brings them back.

climax.name: Gong · the end of the show
climax.description: The audience's shared decision that the moment has come: they are satisfied with the current setting, or tired of it. It takes 3 people tapping together to sound it. It is the end-of-show signal: the gong strikes 3 times while all the music fades out in stages.
